rewritten_description:
New Giloy Powder 100g is a traditional Ayurvedic herbal supplement made from the Guduchi plant, also known as Giloy. This shrub has been used for centuries in Ayurvedic practices for its potential to support overall well-being. The Guduchi plant is believed to have adaptogenic properties, which may help the body adapt to stress. Our Giloy Powder is made from high-quality, pure Guduchi extract, carefully processed to preserve its natural properties.

The Guduchi plant has been a part of traditional Ayurvedic practices for its potential to promote balance and harmony in the body. It is believed to have antioxidant properties, which may help protect the body from oxidative stress. Our Giloy Powder is a convenient way to incorporate this traditional herb into your daily routine.

Direction for use: Take 3 gms powder, 1 to 2 times a day
